transcript: On July 20, 1969, humanity stood on the moon. The Apollo 11 mission began after many years of preparation. Had it not been for Kennedy's speech of 1961, such a challenge to technology might never have begun. The moment Armstrong set foot on the moon, people all over the world watched the scene. his brief words became a gift to all humanity. Without the dedication of countless engineers, that moment could not have happened. Each person's contribution supported this single great feat. On that day, humanity began to write new history beyond Earth. This was a truly historic moment. After returning safely to Earth The crew carried the memory of that distant world home.
